h: Shabbos Blessing and Holiness Fill Both Chambers of the Heart

p: the early ones would go out
'Come, O bride; come, O bride,'" etc.
that comes to a person immediately at the entrance of Shabbos.
And it is stated in the Tikkunim (Tikkun 48, 85a)
"And the Children of Yisrael shall keep the Shabbos,
to make the Shabbos for their generations":
corresponding to the upper and lower Shechinah," etc.;
who makes a dwelling for them on Shabbos
in the two chambers of the heart,
and the evil inclination is cleared away from there," etc.
the intent is "the heart of the wise man at his right
and the heart of the fool at his left" (Koheles 10:2).
"The heart of the wise man at his right":
that is, that the words of Torah be fixed in his heart;
and on this it says "and He blessed";
וְאָמְרוּ בַּמִּדְרָשׁ (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה יא, א)
and they said in the Midrash (Bereishis Rabbah 11:1):
"'The blessing of Hashem, it makes rich'
שֶׁעַל זֶה מָצִינוּ לְשׁוֹן בְּרָכָה בַּפָּסוּק
for which we find the term "blessing" in Scripture;
and it is increase in the abundance of words of Torah.
And this is why it said "makes rich,"
אֵינֶנּוּ מַנִּיחַ לוֹ לִישַׁן (קֹהֶלֶת ה, יא)
I speak of those rich in Torah," etc.
וְעִיקַּר הַמְכוּוָּן עַל תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
And the main intent is the Oral Torah,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק א מז, ב)
as is written in the holy Zohar (Zohar I 47b):
וְהוּא שֶׁהָעוֹלָם נִבְרָא עַל יְדֵי הַתּוֹרָה
That is, the world was created through the Torah,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בַּמִּדְרָשׁ (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה א, א)
as they said in the Midrash (Bereishis Rabbah 1:1):
"I was the instrument of the craft
of the Holy One, blessed be He"
וְהַשִּׁכְלוּל הָיָה עַל יְדֵי תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
and the perfecting was through the Oral Torah;
and by understanding it is established";
בָּהּ בָּרָא הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא הָעוֹלָם
with which the Holy One, blessed be He, created the world;
that is, by the Oral Torah,
which is understanding one thing from another;
"it is established" — that is, the perfecting.
And the essence of blessing and increase
its letters are counted and transmitted,
and one may not add even a single letter;
"Its measure is longer than the earth,
and this pertains to the heart of the wise man at his right.
And it said, "'And He sanctified' — this is holiness";
this corresponds to the heart of the fool at his left;
for holiness is a matter of separation,
"'You shall be holy' — you shall be separate";
that is, to empty the evil out of it,
"and the evil inclination is cleared away from there."
And corresponding to these two holinesses
And for this reason we find
that it counted the seven days of Creation
and said, "Yosef is called Shabbos," etc.;
it said: "And the day of Shabbos
That is, Shabbos includes the two holinesses:
the holiness of Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
which is increase in words of Torah.
וְאַף דְּחֵלֶק מֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
And although the portion of Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
קִבֵּל כָּל הַתּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה גַּם כֵּן
he received the entire Oral Torah as well,
וְאֶתְּנָה לְךָ אֶת לוּחוֹת הָאֶבֶן וְגוֹמֵר
"And I will give you the tablets of stone," etc.,
which is written about the first Tablets,
And likewise it is expounded in the Midrash
וַיְדַבֵּר אֱלֹהִים אֵת כָּל הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה
Scripture, Mishnah, Talmud and Aggadah, etc.,
אֲפִילּוּ מַה שֶּׁהַתַּלְמִיד שׁוֹאֵל לָהָרַב וְכוּלֵּי
even what a student asks his teacher, etc.;
and this too is a verse
And we find (in the Midrash there, 47:5)
שֶׁאָמַר רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן לְרַבִּי חִיָּיא בַּר אַבָּא
that Rabbi Yochanan said to Rabbi Chiya bar Abba:
"Is it a small thing in your eyes
that I sold something created in six days
וְקָנִיתִי דָּבָר שֶׁנִּיתַּן לְמ׳ יוֹם וְכוּלֵּי
and acquired something given in forty days?" etc.
the Torah, which was given in forty days.
But in truth the Torah was given
only on one day, at the Giving of the Torah,
וְהַלּוּחוֹת גַּם כֵּן נִתְּנוּ בְּיוֹם אֶחָד
and the Tablets too were given on one day;
וְזֶה נִיתַּן לְמֹשֶׁה רַבֵּינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
and this was given to Moshe Rabbeinu, peace be upon him,
"and on them was written according to all the words," etc.;
מְלַמֵּד שֶׁהֶרְאָהוּ הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא לְמֹשֶׁה וְכוּלֵּי
"This teaches that the Holy One, blessed be He, showed Moshe," etc.,
"and what the scribes would in the future innovate";
and this refers to the second Commandments.
And in the last forty days,
when he received the second Tablets,
for the Written Torah he had already received the first time;
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בַּמִּדְרָשׁ (שְׁמוֹת רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה מו, א)
as they said in the Midrash (Shemos Rabbah 46:1):
"and in the second Tablets I give you
And on Shabbos there is blessing and increase in it
for Shabbos is the attribute of Malchus,
we call it the Oral Torah."
"And the day of Shabbos is Moshe Rabbeinu";
and this corresponds to "and He blessed."

p: And it also corresponds to the holiness of Yosef;
and this is what it said: "and He sanctified it"
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (וַיִּקְרָא רַבָּה פָּרָשָׁה כד, ו)
דִּבְכָל מָקוֹם שֶׁאַתָּה מוֹצֵא גֶּדֶר עֶרְוָה
that wherever you find a fence against immorality,
and Yosef HaTzaddik is a chariot for this attribute.
And Shabbos, which is the attribute of Malchus,
corresponding to which is the Name Adnut,
which is the aspect of fear,
"And if I am a master, where is My fear?"
from which the attribute of fear sprouts;
and this is the attribute of Yosef,
And this is why it opened in the Tikkun (24, cited above):
That is, the holiness of Shabbos
for of the Torah it is explicit in the pasuk (Iyov 28:28):
"Behold, the fear of Hashem is wisdom";
and the holiness of the bris
we find also with Yosef HaTzaddik,
who was a chariot for the attribute of Yesod:
And then there come to a person
blessing — the increase and abundance in words of Torah,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בִּרְכַּת ה׳ הִיא תַעֲשִׁיר
as they said, "The blessing of Hashem, it makes rich"
this is the day of Shabbos, as mentioned above;
as it is written, "and He sanctified it."
not to carry out from the private domain
and bring into the public domain," etc.
For so we find in Tractate Shabbos
that it opened with the laws of carrying out,
אַף שֶׁאַחַר כָּךְ נִסְדַּר עַל הַסֵּדֶר
although afterward it is arranged in order,
from the laws of Erev Shabbos:
"The tailor should not go out with his needle";
and afterward "With what may one light,"
שֶׁהוּא דִּינֵי עֶרֶב שַׁבָּת עִם חֲשֵׁיכָה
which is the laws of Erev Shabbos at dusk;
and afterward the laws of Shabbos;
with the laws of carrying out:
which is the essence of the holiness of Shabbos.
And this is what it said afterward:
And as for what it said,
"the early ones would go out to greet the bride,
וַהֲווֹ אָמְרֵי תְּרֵי זִימְנֵי בָּאִי כַלָּה
and they would say twice, 'Come, O bride'"
we do not find that he went out;
and Rabbi Chanina, who said "Come, let us go out,"
לֹא אָמַר רַק שַׁבָּת הַמַּלְכָּה פַּעַם אַחַת
the explanation is that in truth,
comes from the side of Hashem Yisbarach,
"For I am Hashem who sanctifies you,"
to receive the holiness of Shabbos.
And this is what we find in the Gemara:
"Rabbi Yannai would put on his garments
the wording is "he would wrap himself and stand";
that is, he put on Shabbos clothes,
to receive the holiness of Shabbos;
as they said in the Pesikta:
And this is the intent of the Tikkunim,
which said that "the early ones would go out
that is, preparation from their side
to receive the holiness of Shabbos;
וַהֲווֹ אָמְרֵי בָּאִי כַלָּה בָּאִי כַלָּה
"and they would say, 'Come, O bride; come, O bride'"
for the heart of the wise, the blessing,
with increase in the Oral Torah;
and for the heart of the fool, the holiness,
to empty out of it the evil and the evil inclination;
and with this, to receive the holiness of Shabbos.
